title: Text: DET Matt Boyd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: How’s it going? Was thinking about giving you a cold call, but if you want to explain to me what this looks like from a player’s perspective, I’m all ears. 100% off the record, no quotes or anything like that, I know the position you’re in
Talking about the supposed proposal that is coming across?
But I’m sitting here debating it with my writer friend, so I figured I’d reach out. I have thoughts on it
Yeah, pretty much
This is what I texted her: “This is kinda radical, but the players probably.
“They probably should dig their heels in at some point
“And I know it’s not going to be pretty for a lot of them, who aren’t the million-dollar guys and what not, but who owns the game?
“Is this not what it’s coming down to? Because if it’s not at this point, then it’s going to happen at the next CBA, and you’re just wasting time in that regard
“The game cannot happen without the players”
And I am on the outside of things, so yeah. If I were to write a column like that this upcoming week, I’m not sure I know enough about what’s going on to be convictive enough, if that makes any sense

Man. Give me 24 hours to see actual proposal, because the only reason they sent it out is for a reaction. What’s that say in itself about how they’ve handled negotiations publicly without talking to the union? This is bargaining v2.0, lining up for the next one. It didn’t have to be that way, but leave it to a large conglomerate to use a pandemic to try and impose their agenda that they’ve tried to push for for over 40 years.....
So I’m trying to reach out to people to gauge their thoughts on that opinion, in the case that my editor says, “Hey, write something up about that.”

Liked “Man. Give me 24 hours to see actual proposal, because the only reason they sent it out is for a reaction. What’s that say in itself about how they’ve handled negotiations publicly without talking to the union? This is bargaining v2.0, lining up for the next one. It didn’t have to be that way, but leave it to a large conglomerate to use a pandemic to try and impose their agenda that they’ve tried to push for for over 40 years.....”
From this perspective, it seems like MLB is shoving the restart down sports’ fans throats like no other league; I think this is probably, in part, because of the timeline
A pandemic of all things - this is a never-before-happened thing, ever - put all these pieces in place for them

This is off the record Anthony....all of it. It makes sense....I know there will be more tomorrow when they actually send it over. But, we are digging our heels in. One thought, the league has never wanted to share in revenues especially when the league has been booming. When they sold bam tech for hundreds of millions, did they want to share that with us? But, now they want us to tie players salaries to revenues.
100 percent off the record, and I appreciate your trust.
We should have restarted sooner, they’re dragging their feet to raise their bottom line.
It seems.....
The draft restrictions line up perfectly with the minor league eliminations
I will be honest: I think there’s a level too many
But not 40 affiliates
Interesting huh
You guys are in a terrible position, though
But again, I’m way on the outside. But it just seems like they do what they want and there’s no recourse. That stuff about the not playing in front of fans thing?
They’re trying to make us look greedy...but we have all the leverage. If they want us to dig our feet in we will.
Thanks for hearing me out
Last thing, and again, I don’t want to come off as too radical
Of course. Don’t use those quotes please. If u plan on it ask me again and I’ll talk
No worries. This is so far off the record, I’m just curious.
But when I say “the game cannot happen without the players”
You’re not far off lol we’re the straw that stirs the drink.
I mean, first: they’ve gone through this before, in 1994. Nobody wants to hear about baseball going on strike, especially not during a pandemic
And we both know this is about money, and we both know what kind of people the players are fighting against here: They do not become billionaires for no reason, you know? They’re smart dudes

But “the game cannot happen without the players” is like, you guys, collectively, have significant influence, too, and if push comes to shove - I know this is radical lol - but imagine a future, 10-20 years from now where the PLAYERS run the game
So many days walking around the clubhouse aimlessly at work, this would be a great chat lol. One day. Stay safe, appreciate you getting back to me.
Liked “And we both know this is about money, and we both know what kind of people the players are fighting against here: They do not become billionaires for no reason, you know? They’re smart dudes”
Players have and will continue to. Owners think they do, but it always starts to become the players who make it in the end.
